checks.claim: accepts a contingent retrospective assessment of $158,026,000.
checks.evidence: NRC final rule published 2023-09-05 (Federal Register, FR Doc 2023-19009) raises the maximum total deferred premium in 10 CFR 140.11(a)(4) to $158,026,000 per reactor, with an annual standard deferred premium of $24,714,000. No later adjustment located; the next adjustment is due in about 2028 under the five-year cycle (inference from the statute, not stated in the notice).
